metaDescription: See how an EasyGo Spa home massage looks — at home, in a condo or in your hotel room across Metro Manila.
title: Home Massage, Wherever You Are
lead: A look at how a session comes to you — at home, in a condo or in your hotel room.

door.title: At Your Door
door.alt: A client opening her front door to a smiling therapist carrying towels and the EasyGoSpa bag

feet.title: Foot Massage on the Sofa
feet.alt: A therapist massaging a client’s feet on the sofa of a high-floor condo in BGC

towels.title: Ready in Your Hotel Room
towels.alt: A therapist preparing towels for a client resting on her hotel bed at night

stretch.title: Thai Stretch on a Floor Mat
stretch.alt: A therapist guiding a clothed client’s leg into a stretch on a floor mat at home

tea.title: Tea After the Massage
tea.alt: A client in a robe enjoying tea on her sofa after a massage while the therapist packs her bag, the city outside

stones.title: Warm Stones
stones.alt: A therapist placing warm stones on a client’s back as she rests on her own bed

hallway.title: On the Way to You
hallway.alt: A therapist in the EasyGoSpa uniform walking down a condo hallway at night with towels and the EasyGoSpa bag

shiatsu.title: Shiatsu, No Oil
shiatsu.alt: A therapist pressing a seated client’s shoulders in his condo living room, no oil

oil.title: Aromatherapy Oils
oil.alt: A therapist warming essential oil between her hands beside a client resting under a towel

ctaText: Book now and your therapist comes to your home, condo or hotel. Pay in cash when they arrive.
